newsitem.title: USA: National Beverage offers stock program.
newsitem.headline: National Beverage offers stock program.

text.p: National Beverage Corp said that it offered a stock program to employees and officers of the company.

The program enables participants to purchase shares of the company's stock in the open market. In return, a participant receives a grant of stock options equal to 50 percent of the number of shares acquired in the open market.
National Beverage is a holding company for various operating subsidiaries that market, manufacture and distribute its full-line of branded cola, multi-flavored soft drinks, juices and bottled water.
